pages.text: The world grows harder in three stages. $(l)Expert$() begins the first time anyone crosses into another dimension. $(l)Master$() begins when the Ender Dragon falls.

Some mobs now travel in packs behind a leader. Kill enough undead and an $(l)Undead Army$() comes for you, with Born in Chaos horrors in its ranks.$(br2)Think twice before that first trip to the Nether.
Gear forged here is a little stronger than you may be used to, with harder-hitting blades and tougher armor. You'll need it.
